{"full_source_conversation":"supporter: Hello, what can I help you?
seeker: I really sad as my partner walked out on me. Any thoughts what could  cheer me up?
supporter: Was there anything that leads to this?
seeker: Not really. I thought everything was ok between us. That is why it kind of struck me.
supporter: That's terrible and unacceptable behavior.
supporter: How long have you been together?
seeker: I have to agree with you-it is unacceptable, considering that he didn't give me any reasons as to why he did it. We have been together for 5 years. 
supporter: That sucks. I wouldn't be able to accept either. 
supporter: Have you talked to your friends about this?
seeker: It is still rather raw,I have mentioned to it to a few of my friends and they deeply symphatise with me but I feel there is nothing much they can do to help me.They are as shocked as me to be honest.
supporter: It is understandable to have that reaction. I agree with you, only us can hep ourselves.
supporter: Have you tried doing activities that help distract you from having negative thoughts?
seeker: Kind of, most of it involves eating loads of ice cream LOL. 
supporter: Haha I feel you, I tend to eat a lot when depressed too. Look, it's treat yourself method. You deserve the best
supporter: If you can go to the mountain or big lake, I would say try spending a few hours there. Maybe have a mini picnic by yourself and enjoy the nature.
seeker: That is a brilliant idea,I do love walking and being outdoors. :) 
seeker: It surely would help me to clear my mind
supporter: Is there anything you have wanted to do but don't have the time? I always want to learn guitar and baking. This is the best time to start that
seeker: oh yeah, I suppose I have more time now to focus on things I have always wanted to do but never kind of had time for it. I bought a high end photo camera ages ago but never really had a chance to use it properly-I guess it is time to pursue my interest in photography, and spending more time outdoors would be ideal for that!
seeker: And reading! The list of books I want to read is arm long!
supporter: That's the spirit! I know being treated like that feels horrible. However, I bet you have mourned enough, at the end of the day, a person treats you like that has no respect and you shouldn't waste time on them.
supporter: It's time to invest in yourself, once you become your better version, a better partner will come to you
seeker: I really agree with you- I am worth more than that. It is time to move on, even when it is difficult. The sad side of it is that I probably will never know what I did wrong for things to end like that. Maybe I didn't do anything wrong. That is the question what will always stay with me and that actually is the hardest bit of it all. But... I am not going to delve into it.
seeker: I feel like hitting a jackpot actually hahahaha. I will be walking off those calories I get from ice cream I have been scoffing lately.So I am having the best of both worlds 
seeker: Who said you cannot have the cake and eat it all LOL
supporter: Yes!Actually don't think you did wrong. Reflecting after a relationship is good but don't put all the blame on yourself.
supporter: You have learned from this relationship too i believe, use that for your next one
seeker: I do not intend to. I am usually the kind of person who does blame oneself but I have found it is not right.","kind":"MS","reported_at":"2024-06-10","schema":"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2","speaker_scope":"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography."}

{"full_source_conversation":"supporter: Hello! What seems to be the problem?
seeker: am having sleep disorder problem
seeker: will you able to help?
seeker: Daily am not able to sleep on time
supporter: I will try my best. I specialise in yoga and meditation.
seeker: Great
supporter: How long has this been happening for?
seeker: past 2 weeks
seeker: will you able to help with some video links
seeker: which I can see and follow
supporter: This may be an obvious question, but can you think of something that has changed in the last two weeks?
supporter: Think about work related, personal life, changes in behaviour?
seeker: yeah. may be work related
seeker: I am spending more time on work
seeker: I need to switch some activities other than work
seeker: will you suggest to take off for few more days from work?
seeker: will that work
seeker: or any other better solution
supporter: It might solve as a temporary solution, however, if whatever happened at work to cause this continues when you return from holidays, you will just have the same problem again.
supporter: What exactly do you think is causing it? Additional work/responsibilities? New manager?
seeker: additional work being assigned to me
seeker: that causes more work stress
seeker: most of them are new to me, so am spending more time to learn 
supporter: Have you tried to speak to your manager about these additional responsibilities? Do you know if it is a short term problem or you will always have extra work being assigned?
seeker: I am trying to speak. but she is not listening much
seeker: let me try to tell my situation and get some better solution
seeker: will you able to share some yoga & mediation links?
seeker: to divert me from the extra additional work
supporter: I don't think I can share links over here, however the activities you perform directly before you go to sleep have a direct impact on your sleeping.
supporter: I would recommend trying to practice 30m-1h of yoga (you can find lodes of exercise videos on the internet to follow), followed by a mediation sound track for you to listen to in bed while you try to sleep.
supporter: Keep your body and mind clear before you go to sleep has proven to allow for a better sleep.
supporter: I used to have sleeping issues, and I started doing this 2 years ago, and I completely changed. I am an investment banker and still am, it is a very stressful environment however this has allowed me to work at the very top and remain in control of my body and mind.
supporter: Please try this for 1 week, I know you can do it and I know it will help you long term.
seeker: Sure. I can try whatever you suggested
seeker: I am sure definitely I will get some changes
seeker: I felt good after chatting with you
supporter: Thanks so good, I have really enjoyed talking to you too.
seeker: Thank you so much for your advice and have a good day.
supporter: My pleasure, you too.
seeker: Bye. closing this chat
supporter: Bye.","kind":"MS","reported_at":"2024-07-25","schema":"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2","speaker_scope":"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography."}
